北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京雾气浓浓，出行请注意安全，呼吸道敏感者多防护。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is foggy. Please drive safely and protect your respiratory health.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪雾气重，能见度低，早晨出门开车要小心哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is very foggy. Visibility is low, so drive carefully this morning!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海雾气弥漫，路面湿滑，请小心慢行，注意保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and roads are damp. Please take care and stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云湿热，体感温度 27℃，记得补水防晒，保持清爽。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and humid at 27℃. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 28℃，多云闷热，注意防晒补水，小心午后雷阵雨。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels 28℃, cloudy and muggy. Hydrate, use sunscreen. Watch for afternoon storms.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雾气浓郁，小心驾驶，多穿一件衣服，体感 25℃ 略凉。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is very foggy. Drive carefully, and wear an extra layer as it feels 25℃.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，气温 22℃，体感舒适。出门记得带伞，以防阵雨。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, 22℃ feels comfortable. Bring an umbrella for possible showers.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温 18℃。早晚温差大，请适时增减衣物哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 18℃. Mind the temperature difference between day and night.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，湿度 95%，闷热感强。注意除湿，保持居家干爽。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, 95% humidity, feeling muggy. Dehumidify your home.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，气温 19℃。出门注意添衣，早晚略显凉意。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, 19℃. Wear extra layers, as mornings and evenings are cool.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，气温 20℃，体感舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, 20℃, feels comfortable. Stay hydrated and cheerful!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 14℃，风力 4级。注意防风保暖，多穿点哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, feels 14℃ with 4-level winds. Dress warmly against the wind.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 17℃。阳光正好，出门散步很舒服，注意防晒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels 17℃. Perfect for a walk, remember sunscreen.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明体感 11℃，多云微凉。请记得多添衣物，小心着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming feels 11℃, cloudy and cool. Please wear more clothes to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门大雾弥漫，能见度低，外出小心驾驶，注意路况哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is very foggy with low visibility. Drive carefully and watch the road.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛大雾，体感 9℃，湿度 99%。风大湿冷，务必注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very foggy, feels 9℃ with 99% humidity. It's windy and damp, dress warmly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连大雾，体感 9℃。湿冷感强，出门记得多添衣物防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is very foggy, feels 9℃. It's damp and cold, dress warmly when going out.
